sanskrit_verse:
निवेशसमयादूर्ध्वं नैते योज्याः कथंचन |
दृष्टिपातं प्रणालीं च न कुर्यात् परवेश्मनि || १,१९.४८
transliteration: niveśasamayād ūrdhvaṃ naite yojyāḥ kathaṃcana | dṛṣṭipātaṃ praṇālīṃ ca na kuryāt paraveśmani ||
sph_interpretive_translation: After the time of entry has passed, these shall not be employed in any manner; one must neither cast a glance nor direct a channel within another's dwelling.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority over space is time-bound and contextually delimited
Causation arises from violation of spatial-temporal thresholds
Capacity-based responsibility includes refraining from visual or infrastructural intrusion
Restoration logic requires withdrawal and non-repetition of transgressions
Consciousness alignment demands respect for the sovereignty of another's domain
executable_legal_axioms: IF time_of_entry > threshold THEN permission_to_act = FALSE
IF agent_casts_glance(at = paraveśman) THEN violation_flag = TRUE
IF agent_directs_channel(to = paraveśman) THEN integrity_breach = TRUE
IF violation_occurs THEN mandatory_withdrawal AND no_reentry_until_realignment
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that temporal boundaries delimit authority. Unauthorized lingering or interference beyond permitted duration constitutes actionable infringement. The court must affirm the sanctity of proprietary thresholds without recourse to punitive measures, ensuring restoration of violated integrity through conscious re-alignment and enforced cessation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through observed temporal and spatial violation. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential overstepping—first of time, then of gaze, then of structural imposition. Proportional responsibility lies in immediate cessation and withdrawal. The non-punitive reality rule asserts that suffering is irrelevant; only realignment with rightful boundaries restores Dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Mandatory exit protocol upon expiry of lawful stay
Visual discipline training to prevent unauthorized observation
Infrastructure redirection to remove encroaching channels
Integrity audit to confirm cessation of all intrusions
Reintegration process contingent upon acknowledgment of boundary transgression
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through recognition of temporal and spatial sovereignty. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the supreme adjudicator.
